interpretation.hamiltonian: Hermitian linear operator/matrix under declared basis ordering
interpretation.approximation_metric: operator norm unless a benchmark explicitly declares a stronger/different metric
interpretation.product_formula: composition order, time normalization, and step count are proposition data
interpretation.artifact_mapping: source Hamiltonian, decomposition, and emitted circuit must be separate checked obligations

notes: Target profile for publication-grade Hamiltonian approximation claims; numerical entry-wise error is not automatically an operator-norm guarantee.
